notes: Fixes how a One-Line Diagram circuit's wrapped line connects itself when it wraps to a new row (too many devices, or a floor separator). Previously a wrap could land in the middle of the next row's floor-separator dash instead of cleanly at its left start, and a solid connector line could get drawn on top of a dash and hide it. Every wrap now connects with a clean right-angle corner from the true end of one row to the true start of the next, and dashes always render on top so they're never hidden.
